item.description: Prime Minister Sanae Takichi has made a significant statement regarding the cryptocurrency SANAE TOKEN ($SANAET), categorically denying any involvement with the token on March 2. Takichi stated that she was completely unaware of the existence of the token, and her office had not granted any form of approval. item.title: PFAS Levels Detected at DIC Factory: Urgent Action Required in Ishikawa
item.description: In a concerning development, PFAS levels have been detected in the underground water at DIC’s Hokuriku factory in Hakusui, Ishikawa, exceeding environmental guidelines significantly. On March 3, the Ishikawa Prefectural Government announced that 19 wells within a 500-meter radius of the site had surpassed established safety benchmarks.
